source: The tragedy of Everly Praetis unfolds through the lives of characters in Asbury Pines across eras of town history. While each era in the town’s timeline offers unique characters and stories, sometimes the characters in future eras can only advance their lives by exploring the stories or using the resources from characters in past eras. Hint: Worm83 is an apocalyptic era of societal collapse – the town’s resource production systems have been destroyed. Find another way to collect experience! Tip: Use the buttons in the bottom-right corner of the screen (below resource notifications) — to cycle through unlocked eras.
target: 艾芙莉・普雷蒂斯的悲劇，透過阿斯伯里松林鎮不同歷史時代的角色人生，逐步展開。每個時代都有獨特的人物與故事；有時，未來時代的角色必須探索過去角色的故事，或使用他們生產的資源，才能推進自己的人生。 提示：蠕蟲83是社會崩潰的末日時代，鎮上的資源生產系統已遭摧毀。請找出其他取得經驗的方法！ 小技巧：使用畫面右下角、資源通知下方的按鈕，即可循環切換已解鎖的時代。

source: Perks offer a range of boosts to character skills, resource production, and resource flow. They help strategically maximize the efficiency of Asbury Pines characters and their actions across eras. Note: Perks that refer to “all characters” affect every character across the timeline (including plants and animals). Note: Only fully-researched, 100% perks are unlocked on the Perks page.
target: 加成項目能提升角色技能、資源生產及資源流動，幫助你以策略性的安排，讓阿斯伯里松林鎮各時代的角色與行動發揮最高效率。 注意：寫明影響「所有角色」的加成，會作用於整條時間線上的每個角色，包括植物與動物。 注意：只有研究進度達到100%的加成，才會在加成頁面解鎖。

source: Characters from the past are able to generate resources and experience for the future, but typically at lower rates. The Production Flow tab shows the types of resource conversions occuring across eras, and the rate at which the past resources flow into future eras. Hint: Researching certain Religions can boost the rate of resources flowing into future eras.
target: 過去的角色能為未來產生資源與經驗，但通常會以較低的比率傳遞。「生產流程」頁面會顯示跨時代的資源轉換種類，以及過去資源流向未來時代的速率。 提示：研究某些宗教，可以提高資源流向未來時代的速率。

source: Why can I still use a character that is dead? “Dead” characters may still be used after their deaths are revealed because characters represent their legacies and contributions, not their lifespans, in the grand timeline of Asbury Pines. Should this character be able to work here? Characters may operate at locations that may appear illogical, but some tolerance is appreciated here to facilitate proper gameplay/balance. Why don't these dates line up? Precise beginning/end dates of eras are loosely defined (much like in our own history). This may cause some overlap in the listings of in-game dates in stories, events, etc. Why does the Perks page start at 100? The perks list starts at 100 to make them easily distinguishable by grouping (Religion, Science, Government) and the order of their advancement. Why doesn't the Perks page list what I'm researching? Perks are not unlocked (on the Perks page) until Government, Science, or Religion cards are 100% completed on their respective pages. How do I 100% a Nature Location or Scavenging Zone? Only fully-explored nature locations and fully-scavenged scavenging zones will appear “100%” complete. Why are some characters not on the Quest Tree? Though the Quest Tree does not include every story and character, each life is still significant: everyone bears an impact on the history around them. Why are dates unordered on the Stories page? Dates on the Stories page may appear out of order until the player sorts the dates chronologically. Why can't I see this character's name on the timeline? Some long names are temporarily cutoff on the character timeline pages (orange names) because the previous era has not yet been unlocked.
target: 為什麼角色死了之後還能使用？ 即使故事已揭示角色的死亡，仍可使用這些「已死」的角色。在阿斯伯里松林鎮的宏大時間線中，他們代表的是留下的影響與貢獻，而非壽命本身。 這個角色應該能在這裡工作嗎？ 有些角色能在看似不合邏輯的地點活動。為了遊戲性與平衡，敬請容許這些安排。 為什麼有些日期對不上？ 各時代的起迄日期採較寬鬆的界定，就像真實歷史一樣。因此，故事、事件等內容列出的日期，可能出現部分重疊。 為什麼加成頁面的編號從100開始？ 從100開始編號，是為了方便依類別（宗教、科學、政體）及進展順序辨認。 為什麼加成頁面沒有列出我正在研究的項目？ 必須先在政體、科學或宗教頁面，將相應卡片完成至100%，加成才會在加成頁面解鎖。 如何把自然地點或拾荒區域完成到100%？ 只有完全探索的自然地點，以及完全拾取完畢的拾荒區域，才會顯示100%完成。 為什麼有些角色不在任務樹上？ 任務樹並未包含所有故事與角色，但每個生命仍然重要：每個人都影響了周遭的歷史。 為什麼故事頁面的日期沒有依序排列？ 在玩家選擇按日期排序之前，故事頁面的日期可能不按時間先後排列。 為什麼時間線上看不到某個角色的完整姓名？ 如果前一個時代尚未解鎖，角色時間線上部分較長的姓名（橘色姓名）會暫時被截斷。

source: Researching Governments will yield boosts to character Work skills and to Work locations, as well as offer resource bonuses. Note: Each phase of a government perk that is researched yields a portion of the total value of that perk. For example, with 3 of 5 phases researched for a 5% boost to work location speed, 3% of that park is active.
target: 研究政體，可提升角色的工作技能與工作地點的效率，並獲得資源獎勵。 注意：政體加成每完成一個研究階段，就會啟用該加成總效果的一部分。例如：某加成共有5個階段，全部完成可提升工作地點速度5%；完成其中3個階段時，便已啟用3%的加成。

source: Only certain characters can “Examine” an artifact to yield a bonus of resources and/or Experience. Artifacts are unlocked through the progression of characters’ lives and stories.
target: 只有特定角色能「檢視」文物，獲得資源及／或經驗獎勵。文物會隨著角色人生與故事的推進而解鎖。

source: Creatures interact with the bustling settlements across the history of Asbury Pines. Their stories contribute to the ultimate destiny of the area.
target: 在阿斯伯里松林鎮的歷史中，生物們與熱鬧的聚落交會。牠們的故事，也參與塑造了這片土地最終的命運。

source: Characters use Nature Zones to convert refined materials from Work Zones into life “Experience.” These Experience points are used on the character timeline. Select “Live Life” next to a character to advance their lives and unlock stories, events, and places within the sprawling mystery and history of Asbury Pines.
target: 角色利用自然地點，把工作地點產出的精製材料轉換成人生「經驗」。這些經驗用於推進角色時間線。選擇角色旁的「過生活」，就能推進其人生，解鎖故事、事件與地點，深入阿斯伯里松林鎮盤根錯節的謎團與歷史。

source: Characters scavenge for raw resources that are then used in Work Zones to create refined materials. Scavenged resources are also needed to build Work Zones. Some characters are more efficient at scavenging than others, based on their unique skills. Stories unlock new Scavenging Zones.
target: 角色透過拾荒取得原始資源，再交由工作地點加工成精製材料。建造工作地點也需要拾荒所得的資源。角色各有不同技能，因此拾荒效率也不盡相同。故事會解鎖新的拾荒區域。

source: Characters from the past may be used to generate resources for the future, but typically at a discount. This includes experience!
target: 過去的角色能為未來產生資源，但通常會折算後傳遞。經驗也包含在內！

source: When first launching the game, it may display with a shifted or abnormal window position. When this happens, the “Ok” button under the Present Era Banner may be hidden. To fix this issue, adjust the game's window in Settings until no content is hidden by either activating “Fullscreen” mode or adjusting the “UI Zoom” slider as needed.
target: 第一次啟動遊戲時，視窗的位置可能偏移或顯示異常，導致當代時代橫幅下方的「確定」按鈕被遮住。遇到這種情況，請到設定頁調整視窗：啟用全螢幕模式，或視需要調整介面縮放滑桿，直到所有內容都能完整顯示。

source: A type of story that has community-wide repercussions to the area of Asbury Pines. Community Events signal a change in society, the environment, or a notable moment in history.
target: 這類故事會對阿斯伯里松林鎮整個社群產生影響。社群事件代表社會或環境的變化，或歷史上值得注意的一刻。

source: Stories unlock new characters, locations, and eras that expand the production of resources. Having characters "Live Life" will unlock new stories. The stories that are particularly important to the mystery surrounding the tragedy of Everly Praetis will appear in the Quest Tree. Note: Every story is not part of the grand mystery within the Quest Tree, but all bring detail and insights to the people, places, and happenings shaping the town’s timeline.
target: 故事會解鎖新角色、新地點與新時代，擴大資源生產。讓角色「過生活」，即可解鎖新故事。與艾芙莉・普雷蒂斯悲劇背後的謎團特別相關的故事，會出現在任務樹上。 注意：並非每篇故事都是任務樹大謎團的一部分，但所有故事都能帶來細節與洞見，呈現塑造小鎮時間線的人物、地點與事件。

source: These are the denizens of the quiet town of Asbury Pines, and the communities that precede and follow it across past and future eras. Manage their work to create resource production flows. Use resources from their work to progress their lives. Explore the stories in their lives to unveil answers to a sprawling mystery and unlock new characters, locations, and eras. Note: Characters have unique skill levels. Higher skill levels equate to higher speeds of actions related to that skill.
target: 這些角色居住於寧靜的阿斯伯里松林鎮，以及過去與未來不同時代、先於或後於它存在的社群。安排他們的工作，建立資源生產流程，再用工作所得的資源推進人生。探索他們生命中的故事，逐步解開龐大的謎團，並解鎖新角色、新地點與新時代。 注意：各角色有不同的技能等級。技能等級越高，相關行動的速度就越快。

source: The quiet observers of Asbury Pines and its surroundings. They create Experience and their stories are a part of the history and mystery of the town.
target: 它們是阿斯伯里松林鎮及周邊地區沉默的觀察者。它們能產生經驗，而它們的故事也是小鎮歷史與謎團的一部分。

source: Stories make the town of Asbury Pines grow – they unlock residents, eras, and resource production areas. You reveal stories by selecting “Live Life” on the characters in your People page. But Living Life costs Experience, which is made from a production loop of gathering and refining resources. If you run out of Experience: 1. Go to the Scavenging Zones page and assign characters to scavenge for raw resources (or research artifacts on the Artifacts page to get them). 2. Go to the Work page and build a work area from raw resources. Then assign characters to the work area to convert raw resources into refined materials. 3. Go to the Nature Locations and assign characters to the Nature Location to convert refined materials into Experience. Return to the People page and use the Experience to “Live Life” of characters to get their stories, which stretch and stitch together on the Quest page to solve a grand mystery. As you advance, this production loop grows in scale, puzzle, and gentle complexity.
target: 故事讓阿斯伯里松林鎮成長，解鎖居民、時代及資源生產區域。在人物頁面選擇角色的「過生活」，即可揭開故事。但生活需要消耗經驗，而經驗來自收集與加工資源所構成的生產循環。若經驗用完了： 1. 前往拾荒區域頁面，指派角色收集原始資源；也可以到文物頁面研究文物，取得資源。 2. 前往工作頁面，用原始資源建造工作地點，再指派角色工作，把原始資源轉換成精製材料。 3. 前往自然地點頁面，指派角色將精製材料轉換成經驗。回到人物頁面，使用經驗讓角色「過生活」，取得他們的故事。這些故事會在任務頁面延伸、交織，逐步解開宏大的謎團。 隨著遊戲推進，這個生產循環的規模與解謎內容會逐漸增加，複雜度也會平緩上升。

source: Researching Religions will yield boosts to character Scavenging skills, Life skills, Scavenging locations, and the flow rates of resources to future eras, among other bonuses.
target: 研究宗教，可提升角色的拾荒技能、生活技能、拾荒地點效率，以及資源流向未來時代的速率，並帶來其他加成。

source: Characters build Work Zones and use them to convert scavenged resources into refined materials. Some characters are more efficient at working than others, based on their unique skills. Stories unlock new Work Zones that can be built.
target: 角色建造工作地點，將拾荒取得的資源加工成精製材料。角色各有不同技能，因此工作效率也不盡相同。故事會解鎖可建造的新工作地點。

source: Researching Sciences will yield boosts to character Nature skills and to Nature locations.
target: 研究科學，可提升角色的自然技能，以及自然地點的效率。
